proposed_comments.title: Prepare each query component once for the window set
proposed_comments.body:
### Prepare each query component once for the window set

**Severity:** `medium`

`ScoreFunction` calls `WindowSearchScorer.Score` independently for every open window. Each call splits and joins the same query, then alternates the whole query and each word through `FuzzyStringMatcher`, whose thread-local cache retains only one prepared needle; with N windows and W words this repeatedly rebuilds the same W+1 prepared queries and allocates per candidate on every keystroke. Batch scoring across the window collection so each whole query or word is prepared once, while preserving the current scores and ordering, and add coverage that the batch results equal individual scoring.

confidence.rationale: The live call path scores once per candidate, while FuzzyStringMatcher's inspected thread cache stores exactly one needle, so alternating whole-query and per-word calls deterministically evict and rebuild preparations for every window.
